Scrape the financial-statements HTML page for /sites/default/files/inline-files/*.pdf links and GET each annual report PDF (no auth). Poll the Career Opportunities page (HTML) for A5 job signals. Filenames are not fully predictable across years, so parse the page rather than guessing URLs.

WordPress site — scrape /raporte-vjetore/ for annual-report PDF links (wp-content/uploads paths) and /category/njoftime/ (paginated /page/N/ or WP RSS /category/njoftime/feed/) for jobs/announcements (A5).

Download the Bulgaria country PDF and the master 'Facts & Figures' reports from ebf.eu/wp-content/uploads/ each December; direct PDF fetch via curl, no auth. Latest: F&F 2025 (2024 stats) at /wp-content/uploads/2025/12/EBF-Fact-and-Figures-2025-18-December-2025.pdf.

GET the per-issue PDF via URL pattern /sr/oglasi/[NNN-YYYY]/pdf/[lat|cir] for the classifieds/tenders section and /sr/propisi/[issue]/pdf/[lang] for regulations. Enumerate issue numbers by year off /sr/pregled.

Poll /feed/ (application/rss+xml, HTTP 200) for latest articles; country-specific feed (/category/croatia/feed/) returns 404, so filter by keyword (Bulgaria/Croatia) or use the site search + WordPress ?s=...&feed=rss2 pattern.
Pull RSS from https://www.efsyn.gr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, 200) and/or scrape the section page https://www.efsyn.gr/oikonomia/ergasiaka. WebFetch is 403-blocked; use curl with a UA.
Pull WordPress RSS at https://pamehellas.gr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, 200); no auth. Filter for banking-sector items.
Pull WordPress RSS at https://www.seytpe.gr/feed/ (application/rss+xml, 200) and/or scrape announcements list; no auth.
Poll RSS https://www.banka.hr/feed/ (HTTP 200, application/rss+xml) for banking news; scrape category/bank-profile pages for deeper A5 early-intent signal.

Scrape the careers HTML for the department/job list, or enumerate individual job posts via sitemap.xml (each /jobs/<slug> with lastmod). No public JSON API — tested /api/public/jobs returned 404. Static HTML/XML, no login, easily automatable.
Poll RSS feed https://poduzetnik.biz/feed/ (WordPress, valid RSS 2.0 XML confirmed) and/or category feeds; filter for banking/payments/fintech keywords.
Poll RSS feed https://www.helloworld.rs/rss/ (200, application/rss+xml, valid RSS 2.0) for new IT job posts; supplement with HTML scrape of /oglasi-za-posao (paginated 1..240). No auth/JS needed.

Consume RSS feed (https://mondo.ba/rss/629/Naslovna, 200, text/xml, valid items) for latest items; supplement with HTML scrape of /info/Ekonomija (paginated 1-5) for economy-only filtering. Feed 629 is 'Naslovna' (homepage); a category-specific Ekonomija feed id may also exist.
Consume WordPress RSS at /feed/ (200, application/rss+xml). Category feeds available (WordPress pattern /category/<slug>/feed/, e.g. Kapital, Investicije, 'Kompanije i Tenderi'). No JS/auth.

Consume RSS at https://www.rtrs.tv/vijesti/rss.php (valid RSS 2.0). NOTE the latin subdomain path https://lat.rtrs.tv/vijesti/rss.php returns 'File not found' — use the www.rtrs.tv host for the feed. Supplement with HTML /vijesti/najnovije.php (has Ekonomija category) for economy filtering.

Scrape HTML listing pages: Greece press releases (https://www.deloitte.com/gr/en/about/press-room/press-releases.html) and industry/insights hubs (banking-capital-markets, financial-services, tax alerts). Headlines/links are server-rendered in the HTML, so a plain GET + HTML parse works, no browser session or auth needed. For research reports (Digital Banking Maturity, Regulatory Outlook) follow article pages to linked PDFs and download individually as needed.

Scrape HTML insight/industry pages. Poll the regulatory-insights hub (https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/regulatory-insights.html) and the annual '20xx Financial Services Regulatory Priorities' articles for A3; scrape Greece People Services pages (executive-search-selection.html, compensation-benefits-surveys.html) and industries/banking.html for A2/A5. Follow /home/ -> non-/home/ 301 redirects. Some barometer/radar reports link to PDFs behind marketing/registration forms — flag those individually.

Scrape paginated HTML: GET https://www.temenos.com/press-releases/page/N/ (N=1..54, path-based pagination returns server-rendered HTML, no JS/auth needed). Filter deal/partner/go-live announcements; parse date-stamped entries. Same pattern applies to https://www.temenos.com/success-stories/ for customer case studies.

Scrape investors.dieboldnixdorf.com/news-and-events/press-releases (IR platform, year-indexed URLs .../press-releases/news-details/2026/...) or news.dieboldnixdorf.com/press-releases. IR sites usually expose an RSS feed - check for one.

Scrape the HTML project register at https://www.eib.org/en/projects/loans/index.htm?countries=GR (signed loans) and https://www.eib.org/en/projects/all/ (paginated); also monitor procurement page https://www.eib.org/en/about/procurement/index. No public CSV/JSON export; data.europa.eu EIB dataset distributions merely link back to these HTML pages. All three sample URLs return HTTP 200.

download.type: PDF/DOC (prospectus and decision attachments linked from issuances and legislation pages)

sources.recommended_method: Scrape with a plain HTTP GET client (curl/requests) sending a real browser User-Agent header — this bypasses the Cloudflare bot rule that returns 403 to WebFetch/default agents. Pages are fully server-rendered, no JS or API needed. Crawl the issuer register at /ucesnici-na-trzistu/emitenti (one page, ~855 rows), then follow each /ucesnici-na-trzistu/emitenti/{code} profile for per-issuer tables. Poll /novosti, /obavjestenja, /finansijski-izvjestaji and /odluke/odobrenja-emisije-vp-javnom-ponudom for A3/A1/A4 updates and parse linked PDF/DOC files. Add polite rate-limiting (one request timed out once; retry logic recommended).

HTTP GET on server-rendered pages: /press (EN newsroom) and /hr-HR/novosti (Croatian news/blog), paginate via ?p=N (e.g. /press?p=1). Also /hr-HR/regulatory-info (A3 regulation) and /about (A1). Content is present in raw HTML, so plain curl/HTTP fetch works without a browser. For job openings (A5), the /careers page renders the list via a Talentlyft JS widget (talentlyftWidget) rather than server HTML, so use the Talentlyft feed/widget or a headless browser for jobs specifically.

Static HTML scraping. Crawl section landing pages (news /bs/novosti/kratke-vijesti and /bs/novosti/bhbankar, events /bs/dogadjaji, jobs /bs/novosti/zaposljavanje, tag pages e.g. /bs/novosti/tag/platni_promet, member banks /bs/banke-clanice, documents /bs/dokumenti/prezentacije) then follow item detail links. English mirror under /en. Pages are server-rendered, so plain HTTP GET + HTML parser (BeautifulSoup/Cheerio) works; no JS execution or login needed. robots.txt allows all crawling. Downloadable files (PDF/PPT White Books, presentations) live on document detail pages - follow through to capture direct file links.
Scrape HTML. Paginate the awards-ranking hub (52 pages) and winner-announcements list; filter articles mentioning Greece / Best Bank in Greece. Server-rendered, no auth.

Scrape HTML. Start from all-results index and country-award archive (https://www.euromoney.com/awards-articles/country-award/), follow the yearly 'national winners ... Greece' article URLs. Server-rendered content is retrievable without JS/login. Full award-entry portal (euromoney.awardsplatform.com) requires submission login and is not needed for winner lists.

Scrape static HTML listing https://usa.visa.com/about-visa/newsroom/press-releases-listing.html (headlines+links present in server HTML, no JS needed); follow /about-visa/newsroom/press-releases.releaseId.<ID>.html for full text. No RSS/API exposed.

Scrape the blog index (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/blog -> redirects to /blog-international), the press/newsroom page (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/press, 'More press releases...' link), and localized editions (Bulgarian: https://www.paysera.com/v2/bg/blog-bulgaria; Albania articles under /v2/en/blog/*-albania). Article titles + dates are in server-rendered HTML (curl/WebFetch works on article/blog/press pages). Use a realistic browser User-Agent because the site root returns HTTP 403 to bare curl (bot protection); article and section pages return 200. Career/jobs at /v2/en/career for A5. No RSS feed found.

GET each page with a real browser User-Agent header (site is behind Cloudflare which 403s default/WebFetch agents but serves 200 to a normal Mozilla UA); parse the embedded <script type=application/ld+json> ItemList to get job name + url for each listing (confirmed: 50 ListItem entries per results page, e.g. name='Cost Control Senior Associate' url=/jobs/finance-jobs/289831). Paginate results pages; harvest company profiles at /companies/<slug>. No auth needed.

HTML scraping of the ASP.NET pages (no browser/JS needed; curl+WebFetch return full content, HTTP 200, IIS/10.0). For the full issuer universe, iterate the A-Z index EmitentiIndex.aspx?l=<letter> (a..z / local chars) to collect EmitentiFull.aspx?id=<UUID> detail links, then fetch each detail page. Recent-changes and prospectus/session/announcement lists are paginated via ASP.NET __doPostBack POSTs carrying __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION, or scrape sequential list pages. Download prospectus/regulation PDFs directly from their href links.

HTML scraping. Crawl section pages (/finance/, /business, /economics, /company) and tag/company pages (/about/{tag}) which contain article links directly in static HTML (content-type text/html). Paginate with ?page=N (tested ?page=2 -> HTTP 200). Article pages follow /{category}/{slug}.html and are also static HTML. Respect robots.txt crawl-delay: 10s. No auth/cookies/JS needed.

Poll RSS feeds (https://www.index.hr/rss and https://www.index.hr/rss/vijesti) via simple HTTP GET for latest business/regulation news (A1/A3); returns clean XML with category tags, no auth/JS needed. For topical monitoring (A1/A3), scrape the HTML tag pages (all HTTP 200) e.g. /tag/796/hnb.aspx, /tag/53893/kreditni-rejting.aspx, /tag/232442/biznis.aspx, /tag/1040094/fintech-konferencija-shift-money.aspx, /tag/178044/businesshr.aspx and follow /clanak links. For A5 early-intent monitor the banking jobs board at https://www.index.hr/oglasi/poslovi/bankarstvo.

Scrape HTML job-listing pages: GET https://www.randstad.gr/theseis-ergasias/s-trapezikos-klados/ (EL) and https://www.randstad.gr/en/jobs/q-banking/ (EN), parse job cards (title/location/type/date); follow pagination query params. For A5 early-intent, scrape banking vacancies periodically. For HR-trends/press insights (A4/A5), scrape the /hr-trends/ and /en/about-us/press-releases/ HTML pages. No auth or JS rendering needed.

For A1 corporate disclosures: scrape the financial statements download hub (https://www.hbor.hr/naslovnica/hbor/financijska-izvjesca-pregled-preuzimanje/) and the financial plans page for PDF/DOCX links; a fixed publication calendar exists (Q1 by 31 May, H1 by 31 Aug, 9M by 30 Nov, annual by 30 Apr) so poll around those dates. English equivalent at /financial-performance/322. For A3/A5 news: scrape /category/obavijesti (news/priopcenja) and /otvoreni-natjecaji (open calls). For A2 tenders/procurement: HBOR's own /javna-nabava/132 only holds rules + archive; active tenders are published on Croatia's national e-procurement portal EOJN (https://eojn.nn.hr/Oglasnik/) — collect HBOR tenders there by contracting authority.

Plain HTML scrape of the bilingual page set: /en/about-us/overview/ (and /hr/), /en/company-data/, /en/merchants-solutions/overview/ and /card-acceptance/acquiring-agreements/, /en/banks-and-financial-institutions/acquiring/atm-solutions/. Static server-rendered HTML, no JS or API needed. Use these for A1 (company profile/management), A6 (vendor/competitor product & acquiring/ATM offering). Note: Nexi Croatia d.o.o. does NOT publish financial statements or annual reports on this site — for A1 financial disclosures collect them from the Croatian court/company registry (sudreg.pravosudje.hr) or FINA rgfi by OIB, not from nexi.hr.
Scrape the static HTML newsroom card grid at /newsroom and follow 'Browse All' to the knowledge hub. No RSS/JSON found; periodic HTML scrape. Cloudflare-fronted, /en/global paths 301 to root.

Scrape HTML from https://ethosevents.eu/en/upcoming-events/ for event names + dates (static, category-tabbed), and per-event pages under /en/event/<slug>/ for agenda/sponsors/speakers (A5 early-intent, A6 vendors). Apologismoi recaps under /apologismoi/<slug>/. EN and EL variants exist.

download.type: XLSX (bank financial statements) + PDF/TIF/JPEG scanned documents under /documents/

sources.recommended_method: Scrape server-rendered company pages via NIPT URL pattern https://opencorporates.al/{sq|en}/nipt/{NIPT} (HTTP GET, Cloudflare-fronted but 200 for normal requests, no JS/auth). Enumerate via category listing pages (e.g. /sq/concession, banking category) then follow NIPT links. Harvest attached financial-statement files under /documents/bilanci/ and /documents/dokumenta/. Also cross-reference AIS sibling portals (opendata.al, openprocurement.al) for CSV/JSON.

Poll RSS feeds https://www.bta.bg/en/rss/free (English) and https://www.bta.bg/bg/rss/free (Bulgarian) via simple HTTP GET (text/xml, no auth, updatePeriod hourly) for new items; for section pages fetch HTML listings like https://www.bta.bg/en/news/economy and follow article links (e.g. /en/news/671544-... which returns 200). No JS needed for server-rendered HTML.

Poll the RSS feeds (e.g. https://www.economic.bg/rss/all.xml for all news, https://www.economic.bg/rss/biznes.xml, /rss/sektorni-novini.xml, /rss/biznes-radar.xml) for A1/A3/A5/A6 monitoring; supplement with HTML scraping of the Finance/Banks category page (/bg/category/finansi/banki.html) which is server-rendered and paginated. No JS or auth needed. Filter items by bank/ABB/fintech keywords.

Scrape server-rendered HTML with a plain HTTP client (no JS needed). Crawl /oglasi and category pages /kat/<slug> for listings; fetch employer pages at /poslodavci/<slug>/<id> for company detail and active/expired ads. Company URLs use the /poslodavci/ path (older /companies/ paths 301-redirect to /poslodavci/).
GET RSS https://thefintechtimes.com/feed/ (application/rss+xml). Category feeds also available (e.g. /category/<x>/feed/). Note: wp-json REST API is blocked (403).

Scrape the media-centar listing page (HTTP 200, static server-rendered HTML) with plain HTTP GET; parse dated items and follow individual article links. Filter via on-page categories: Sve novosti / Vijesti / Priopcenja. Poll periodically for new-dated items.

HTTP GET scraping of the stable path pattern https://www.infostock.bg/infostock/control/{section}/{TICKER} where section = quotes | statements | issuenews | institutions | bse. Content is fully server-rendered HTML (no JS/API needed) but encoded in windows-1251 — decode to UTF-8 (iconv -f windows-1251) before parsing. Enumerate issuers via /infostock/control/institutions, then pull quotes/statements/issuenews per ticker.

Static HTML scrape of /speakers/, /startups/, /news/ and /agenda with a simple HTTP GET + HTML parser (WordPress-style markup, speaker/startup cards embedded in DOM, no JS execution needed). Re-crawl per conference edition; watch for yearly URL/edition changes.

Retarget collection to the successors: (1) Erste Bank Croatia press releases https://www.erstebank.hr/hr/press/priopcenja-za-medije (A1/A5 news) and financial reports https://www.erstebank.hr/hr/o-nama/financijska-izvjesca (A1 PDFs); (2) Diners Club Hrvatska https://diners.hr/ (card products/news); (3) Global Payments corporate news for the acquiring business; (4) Croatian court register (sudreg.pravosudje.hr) / FINA for Erste Card Club d.o.o. company & management data. Scrape via plain HTTP/HTML; no API or auth needed.

HTML scraping. Content is fully server-rendered (finance category page title 'Financë - Punë aktive - <date>', BKT employer page 'Banka Kombetare Tregtare BKT' both returned in raw HTML), so a plain HTTP GET + HTML parser works without a browser. Crawl /search/category/finance for finance listings and /employers/<slug> for target-employer job activity. No public JSON API or sitemap.xml (404) found; robots.txt exists (200) — respect it.

Plain HTTP GET the /pretraga-poslova search URLs (no auth, no JS needed). Nuxt SSR renders job cards directly into the HTML (1000+ data-v- nodes, job titles/employers present), so parse listings from the returned HTML. Use query params to filter (positions=IT, sortBy=adtype) and paginate. Homepage and /poslovi also return 200. An internal JSON/GraphQL API likely exists (references to baseURL in bundle) but was not needed — SSR HTML is sufficient and reproducible outside a browser.

Plain HTTP GET + HTML parsing (Apache server, HTTP 200, static server-rendered pages, no JS or auth needed). Crawl /propisi/<jurisdiction>/<slug>.html for legal texts, and registar-sluzbenih-glasila.html plus arhiva-sluzbenih-novina-fbih.html for gazette issue links. Content served inline as HTML; poll the register / 'Alarm za glasila' section for new gazette issues.

Scrape https://newsroom.mastercard.com/news/press/ (releases grouped by year, reverse-chronological) and follow per-release article pages; use the Europe region filter for EU-relevant items. No RSS/WP/JSON feed exposed, so plain HTML scraping (or WebSearch site: filter).
Scrape HTML office page for Athens consultant roster and contacts; firm-wide Insights/Thought Leadership live elsewhere on stantonchase.com (not Greece-specific)

Static HTTP GET / HTML scrape of per-act pages (/z/<id>/<slug> and /c/podzakonski-propis/<id>/<slug>). robots.txt allows all; sitemap at https://www.zakon.hr/s/tmp/sitemap/sitemap.xml enumerates all acts. Slugs are versioned yearly (301 redirects to current, e.g. .../-2026) so follow redirects to get latest consolidated text. For official/authoritative text cross-reference Narodne novine (narodne-novine.nn.hr).

download.type: PDF (annual/yearly financial statements, linked from press center)

sources.recommended_method: HTTP GET the press-release.html list and follow ?page= pagination (1..21) to harvest news items (A1/A5/A6); parse static HTML. For financials, scrape the linked 'Годишни финансови отчети' (financial-statements.html) page for annual report PDFs. English mirror under /en_BG/. No JS needed.

Poll the main RSS feed https://www.dnevnik.bg/rss/ (valid RSS 2.0, HTTP 200) for new items, then filter by category/URL path (biznes, finansi, pr_sfera) for A2/A3/A5. Section HTML pages such as /biznes/finansi/ return 200 and can be scraped with a browser-like User-Agent; the homepage and some article pages return 403 to plain curl (CDN/bot protection), so send a realistic UA/Accept header.

HTTP GET scrape of /pretraga-poslova with positions= filter (Bankarstvo, plus IT/payments keyword searches), paginate through result pages and parse listing cards server-side (no JS needed). Respect robots.txt (search results allowed; only specific ?source=/utm params disallowed). Optional: subscribe to per-search e-mail alerts as a change signal.

ndiqparate.al is a reachable WordPress site (bilingual: ?lang=en for English). Scrape article pages by ?p=<id>, ?cat=<id>, ?tag=<slug>. For structured/bulk data follow to the AIS open-data portals (spending.data.al, openprocurement.al, opencorporates.al) which host the actual datasets and are also HTTP-200; check those for CSV/JSON exports/APIs during the collection phase.

Scrape https://facilization.com/news/ and /blog/ for press releases and customer-success/testimonial pages (A1/A5/A6 vendor & client signals). Static HTML, plain HTTP; note www redirects 301 to apex domain.

download.url: Media kit ZIP + brand-asset packages linked from /newsroom (hosted on Google Cloud Storage)

For A5, scrape https://payhawk.com/careers — jobs are server-side rendered into the page and backed by Greenhouse (job_post IDs like 4000039101 visible in the ai_opt_out links); the rendered HTML is directly scrapable without JS.

Plain HTTP scrape (static Apache HTML, no JS). Crawl listing pages /hr/plan-nabavki, /hr/javne-nabavke, /hr/arhiva-javni-nabavki, /hr/ministarstvo-finansija and the hronoloski-registar page; follow detail-page links to PDF documents under /uploads/documents/. Available in bs/hr/sr/en locale prefixes.

Scrape server-rendered HTML lists at https://www.elta.gr/declarations/promitheia-ylikon (and /parochi-ypiresion, /technika-erga, /kanonismoi, or /declarations/all). Each item links to /declaration/<category>/<id-slug> detail pages and to tender PDFs on media.elta.gr. EN mirror at /en/declarations/*. No auth. For A5, scrape /eukairies-karieras (careers) and /team/dioikitiko-sumboulio (board).

Poll RSS feeds: site-wide https://www.dealnews.gr/feed/ and category feeds e.g. https://www.dealnews.gr/trapezes/feed/ and https://www.dealnews.gr/epixeiriseis/feed/. No auth. WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) also likely available if richer data needed.

Poll RSS feeds: site-wide https://www.powergame.gr/feed/ and category feeds https://www.powergame.gr/trapezes/feed/ and https://www.powergame.gr/start-ups-digital/feed/. No auth. WordPress REST /wp-json/wp/v2/posts also likely available.

Scrape HTML section/listing pages (/epixeiriseis/trapezes, /prosopa, /epixeiriseis/texnologia) and follow article links. Not WordPress; no feed. Add polite rate limiting (server returned HTTP 429 on rapid requests).

Scrape HTML pages directly. Server rejects HEAD (405) but GET returns 200 — use GET with a normal browser User-Agent. Collect from /el/grafeio-typou/ (press) and /el/kariera/ (jobs, A5); EN mirror under /en/. No RSS or WordPress REST API exists.

Scrape server-rendered HTML directly (all 4 sample URLs return 200, content readable without JS). Note the POS-terminal URL 301-redirects to the current path .../epixeiriseis-epaggelmaties/trapezika-proionta-upiresies/plirwmes-eisprakseis/apodoxi-trapezikwn-kartwn/ensurmata-termatika-pos — follow redirects. For A1 issuer/IR disclosures consider the group's dedicated investor-relations site as a follow-up.

Poll RSS feed https://financialit.net/rss.xml (HTTP 200, content-type application/rss+xml) for new items, then HTTP GET individual /news/... article pages (static HTML, no JS/login) for full press-release text. Filter by SEE country/vendor keywords for A2/A5/A6 signals.

Periodic HTML scrape of the English (/en/...) and Albanian sections — About Us, Products & Services, Activities, Job Vacancies, Contact — for corporate profile (A1), vendor/competitor intel (A6) and early-intent signals (A5). Content is fully static; simple GET + HTML parse works, no JS/API needed.

sources.recommended_method: Poll the Drupal RSS term feed (/taxonomy/term/392/feed) for FinTech news, and scrape /news/* article pages and office pages (/offices/tirana/albania, /offices/sofia/bulgaria, /offices/zagreb/croatia) for executive appointments as A5 intent signals. Plain HTTP GET, no JS.

Scrape the EN (and BG) HTML pages: /en (home, date/venue), /en/speakers, plus Partners/Advisory Board/Blog for vendor/competitor (A6) and event-driven (A2/A5) intelligence. Static HTML via GET; note WebFetch is 403-blocked but curl with a Mozilla UA returns full content (uses declarative shadow-DOM templates, but content is in the served HTML).

Plain HTTP scrape of the WordPress site. All 4 sample URLs return 200 with plain curl (no JS). Crawl /finansijski-izvjestaji/ and its child pages plus /vijesti/ (konkurs = job postings appear as news items) and /zaposlenje-u-banci/; harvest PDF links under /wp-content/uploads/. English mirror at /en/... , German at /de/... . Optional: WP REST API at /wp-json/wp/v2/ may be available.

Scrape with a real browser User-Agent. Plain curl (default UA) returns HTTP 403 (WAF/bot protection) on the homepage and all sample paths, but WebFetch (browser-like UA) retrieves full content. Set a normal browser User-Agent header, or use a headless browser, then crawl /projects/, /ict-projects/, newshub and /careers/. Careers page has no live vacancy list, it routes to an 'Open Application' talent-platform link; watch the newshub for reference/project announcements.

HTML scrape of per-employer profile pages (path = /<company-slug>, e.g. /printec-croatia, /fina, /pbz-card). Server-rendered HTML; parse rating, employee-count, sector, review counts and any 'aktivni oglasi' (active job ads) block. Croatian language.

Static HTML scrape. Crawl the job listing at /ba/posao/posao.php (mirror /posao/index.php redirects here) and follow individual ad pages at /posao/<numeric id> (verified: /posao/148 = 'Rukovodilac odjeljenja za karticno poslovanje i digitalno bankarstvo'). Scrape /ba/vijesti/index.php for A1/A3 news. Plain Apache GET, no JS/auth. Domains banke.ba and bank.ba are mirrors of the same content.

Static HTML scraping (nginx, server-rendered). Poll /about-us/board/, /events-overview/ (+ past events), and the News/Member News listings. Membership directory at /membership-benefits/membership-directory/ for member org list. No API/JS needed; simple HTTP GET + HTML parse.

Static HTML scrape of /banking-references (client banks: Slatinska, Istarska kreditna, Jadranska, Podravska, Splitska/SocGen, Bosna Bank International, etc.), /banking-solutions and the news blocks. No JS or API needed; nginx serves plain HTML with HTTP 200.
HTTP GET + HTML scrape of /jobs (job cards render server-side, ~100 job/company anchor links present in raw HTML) and /companies/<id> employer pages. Note: HEAD requests return 405, use GET.

Scrape the buyer-profile page (https://fmfib.bg/proceduri) for A2 procurement procedures and the news page (https://fmfib.bg/en/novini or /bg/novini) for A5/A6 signals. Static server-rendered HTML; simple HTTP+HTML parsing works.

NetFAX (https://www.boussias.com/portfolios/netfax/) and Human Resources hub (https://www.boussias.com/human-resources/) both return 200 and are scrapable HTML.

Scrape the press-release listing at https://usa.visa.com/about-visa/newsroom/press-releases-listing.html (individual releases at /press-releases.releaseId.NNNNN.html) and/or corporate.visa.com newsroom; filter for Greece/payments keywords.
No own job board; AIMS Hellas posts openings on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/company/aims-international-hellas) and Skywalker.gr — collect A5 signals there rather than the corporate site
Scrape the static HTML office page for contacts/partners; monitor the site-wide /news-insights section for market commentary. No API/auth. Low structured-data value for A5.
Scrape HTML article; award winners are structured as country/winner lists within the page. No auth. Repeat annually with /awards/world-finance-banking-awards-<year> URL pattern.

Scrape the paginated tenders listing at https://www.e-efka.gov.gr/el/diagonismoi (886 items, ~89 pages, date-range filter available); follow each item link to its detail page for attached tender documents/PDFs. Also cover /el/ilektronikes-ypiresies for e-services.

Static HTTP GET + HTML parse of /bg/jobs (careers, A5/A6) and /bg/news (corporate news, A3/A6). No auth, no JS. English variants under /en/. Poll periodically for new openings/news.

Retire the mercury-processing.com source (domain no longer serves content). Collect from Nexi Group site (nexigroup.com newsroom/press, investor relations) and Nexi Croatia (nexi.hr) for careers/clients; these are the live successor sources for the Croatian card-processing entity.

Scrape server-rendered banking job listings; follow pagination pattern ?professional_field%5B21%5D=21&page=N. Both EN (/en/jobs/banking) and BG (/bg/jobs/banking) versions work. Filters available by region/company/work-type.

For A2: scrape javne-nabavke archive (single-list PDFs). For A3/A5: scrape Novosti. For statistics: use companion domain irbrs.net databases, esp. Periodically scrape /karijere/ for A5 job openings (currently none listed) and product pages (/proizvodi/online-placanja/) for A1/A2 product/vendor intel; check for a WordPress /feed/ if a news/blog section is added.

Static HTML scrape of the WordPress site. Careers listings under /category/careers/ (WP category feed likely available at /category/careers/feed/), vendor/product pages under /card-management-software/ etc. Optionally use WP REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts) if enabled.

Scrape static HTML pages with GET requests: /PressCenter for news/press (A6), /content/read/karijera for jobs (A5), /content/read/o-nama for corporate info. IMPORTANT: use GET not HEAD — the ASP.NET server returns a false 404/Error redirect for HEAD requests.

Scrape static HTML: /v2/en-BG/blog-bulgaria (BG-specific blog/news, A1/A6), /v2/en-BG/career (jobs, A5), /v2/en-BG/about (corporate). Both bg-BG and en-BG language versions available; swap locale segment.
Static HTML scraping of category listing pages (/dogadjanja for events, /tvrtke-trzista, /poslovi) and article pages. No API/RSS documented; standard GET requests work (Apache, 200 OK).

HTML scraping of /njoftime-pune category pages (use the 'finance' category for A5/A6 finance-sector hiring). Listings render server-side in curl (HTTP 200) despite Cloudflare; scrape job title/company/city/type/snippet. Albanian source is primary; /en/ mirror available for English.

Monitor careers page HTML periodically for open roles appearing; supplement with LinkedIn for team/leadership (A6).
Static HTML scraping of uet.edu.al pages (news/career-fair, program pages, ECONOMICUS journal). Crawl news section for A5 early-intent signals; parse program pages directly.

Poll RSS https://forbes.dnevnik.hr/feed/ for A2/A5 signals; supplement with section HTML /rubrika/financije/ and /rubrika/tech/ (paginated). Cloudflare-fronted but curl/WebFetch succeed without JS.

Scrape /vijesti (news, A1) and /zaposlenje (jobs, A5). Harvest PDF reports (auditor report, sustainability report, general business conditions, price list) linked from site. Bosnian + English.

HTML scrape the /ikonomika section (article list, paginated). No /rss feed (404).

Direct HTML scraping (Microsoft-IIS, HTTP 200). Job vacancies are inline HTML text (title, location, deadline, status), not PDFs. Homepage 302-redirects to /naslovnica/. Poll the natjecaji page for new/cancelled postings.

Pull RSS at https://sot.com.al/feed/ (application/rss+xml, 200); also scrape /ekonomia/ section page for economy coverage.

Poll RSS https://balfin.al/feed/ and crawl /media/news/ for A1/A5 corporate signals on Tirana Bank and group companies. LiteSpeed/WordPress, English, no JS or auth.

HTML scraping of /en/ (and /bg/) listing pages plus /job-details/* pages. No third-party ATS (Greenhouse/Lever/Workable) or JSON feed detected; Apache server, static markup.

HTML scraping of the speakers page (Webflow-rendered, content present in static HTML). Optionally check for a Webflow collection JSON, but page text is directly scrapeable for A5/A6 people & company intelligence.
HTML scraping of the management page (board members) and careers page for A5 hiring/leadership signals. Server-rendered (nginx, 200); content present in static HTML.
Scrape HTML listing at https://www.kariera.gr/en/jobs/it-jobs (paginate with ?page=N); each job detail at /en/jobs/it-jobs/<id>. Greek variant at kariera.gr/jobs.
Scrape server-rendered HTML job listings at /jobs/greece and follow pagination; no RSS/API available (tested /rss/greece -> 404).
Scrape HTML for awards categories/winners and speaker lists; annual event, revisit around each spring edition.
Scrape HTML event/agenda/speaker pages; Boussias event microsite, revisit per annual edition.
Scrape static HTML corporate About-us page; low change frequency, periodic re-fetch. For hiring signals use the JPMC Oracle careers API (separate domain) instead.
Scrape server-rendered HTML job listings; not WordPress (wp-json and /feed both 404), so plain HTML scrape with pagination.
Scrape HTML for awards categories/winners; annual KPMG HR awards program, revisit each edition.

For automated collection use headful/stealth browser automation (Playwright/Puppeteer) to obtain a cf_clearance cookie for the session, then: (1) scrape statistika.asp?id=1&s=1 (paginated, 29 pages) to enumerate the monthly /pdf/publikime/*.xlsx report links and fetch each xlsx with the same session cookies + browser User-Agent; (2) scrape registers tt_rregjistrar.asp / tsik_fond.asp and the Official Bulletin (buletini.asp) as HTML; (3) fetch annual report PDFs under /pdf/publikime2/. Use lng=1 for English pages, default for Albanian. Direct curl without cf_clearance will 403.

Collect via a real/headless browser session that solves the Cloudflare managed challenge (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer with stealth + persistent cookies, or a residential-proxy anti-bot scraping service). After the challenge cookie (cf_clearance) is obtained, navigate the category filter URL (categories[]=4) and paginate; parse listing HTML and company profile pages. No official API/RSS/export exists, so DOM scraping of front_job_search.php and /company/{id} pages is the path. Refresh cf_clearance periodically.

download.type: XLS/XLSX (Consolidated Fiscal Programme national methodology); PDF (budget documents, bulletins)

sources.recommended_method: Site is fully public to human browsers but sits behind a Cloudflare 'managed challenge' (anti-bot) that returns HTTP 403 to curl/WebFetch and does not auto-clear in an automated browser session. For automated collection, use a Cloudflare-challenge-capable stack: an undetected/real-browser session (e.g. Playwright/Selenium with stealth, FlareSolverr, or a valid cf_clearance cookie harvested from a genuine browser session) to fetch pages, then follow the XLS/XLSX/PDF links from /en/613 (Statistics), /en/383 (Consolidated Fiscal Programme), /en/documents (paged ?p=N), /en/4 (Budget) and /bg/1738 (Buyer Profile). As a machine-readable alternative for a subset of budget/fiscal datasets, evaluate the national open-data portal data.egov.bg (CSV/JSON/XML) which mirrors some MoF data.

Use updated notices page with Location=Greece filter (public); it is JS/filter-driven, so capture its backing XHR or render headless. For full client notices use ECEPP search (ecepp.ebrd.com/delta/noticeSearchResults.html), viewable without login.

download.type: PDF (financial reports); public 'Javno dostupni podaci' for 2012-2014, full via 'Preuzimanje finansijskih izvjestaja' contract section

sources.recommended_method: HTTP GET the Joomla pages with a real browser User-Agent header (mandatory: default/curl UA is rejected with HTTP 403; Mozilla UA returns 200). Parse register/publication HTML pages directly. For company-level financial reports use the public search pages (Registar finansijskih izvjestaja / Registar poslovnih subjekata); full financial-report PDF downloads require a client contract/login and must be validated manually. Business-subject cross-search is delegated to external portal bizreg.esrpska.com.

Awards landing page loads (HTTP 200) but full award content/results are behind 'Subscribe'/'Sign in' (FT Group paywall). Bank-of-the-Year Greece winners are best collected from the winning banks' own press releases (e.g. Piraeus 2025, Alpha Bank 2024) which are public, or via a paid subscription/browser session.

Requires an authenticated real browser session; Glassdoor blocks automated requests at the edge (Cloudflare 403) and gates content behind login. Use a logged-in browser-session collector (or licensed data partner) with human validation; not reproducible via plain HTTP.

Whole domain is behind Cloudflare 'cf-mitigated: challenge' (JS bot challenge) — HTML pages AND /media/*.pdf files all return 403 to curl/WebFetch. Collect via a real headless browser session (Playwright/Selenium with JS challenge solving / stealth, or the claude-in-chrome browser) to render pages and follow media PDF links. Annual-report PDF URLs are discoverable via search engines (e.g. media/68d4f5bf205a2.pdf = 2024 report, media/651ab4a6cd41a.pdf = 2022, media/636bd0231f656.pdf = 2021).

Requires a real/headless browser session with anti-bot handling (the public Indeed Publisher/Jobs API was deprecated and is not available). Scraping violates Indeed ToS. For automated collection, use a browser-automation session or a licensed jobs-data provider; treat as manual validation.

Requires a real browser session: whole domain sits behind Cloudflare bot protection (returns HTTP 403 to curl and to WebFetch, even with a desktop Chrome User-Agent). Use a headless/full browser that passes the Cloudflare JS challenge (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer with stealth, or the Chrome browser tool) to load /ekonomija (and sub-sections /ekonomija/privreda, /ekonomija/trziste) or the RSS feeds under /rss. Article URLs follow /ekonomija/<sub>/<slug>/<id> and can be crawled once past the challenge.

Site is behind Cloudflare 'challenge' bot protection (cf-mitigated: challenge, JS/Turnstile). All plain HTTP GETs (curl, WebFetch) return HTTP 403 regardless of User-Agent, including the homepage and sitemap.xml. Collect via a real headless browser (e.g. Playwright/Puppeteer with stealth, or the Chrome MCP browser) that executes the Cloudflare JS challenge and holds cf_clearance cookies, then read the procurements/projects tables and any export links from the rendered DOM. No public JSON/CSV API discovered.

Collect via a headless/real browser that solves the Cloudflare JS bot challenge (curl and WebFetch both return HTTP 403). After the challenge, tender listings are plain server-rendered HTML (data embedded in page, not an XHR/JSON API) and can be parsed and paginated (~124 pages). Use the B&H territory filter for Bosnia scope. No login needed for public listings; login only required to post tenders.

Reuters blocks automated access (HTTP 401 on homepage, /markets/ and /tools/rss). Content is bot-protected and subscription-gated. Use official Reuters/LSEG licensed news feed/API or a browser session with a logged-in subscription; do not scrape. Site-search is JS-rendered.

sources.recommended_method: Site is a React SPA (Lovable) backed by Supabase — no WordPress/RSS. Either reverse-engineer the Supabase REST endpoint + anon key from /assets/index-BKmFhpkK.js and query PostgREST directly, or use a headless browser session to render /?s=greece. Flag for manual validation to extract the endpoint.

Seed a crawler from the sitemap (https://electrocoin.eu/sitemap.xml -> sitemap1.xml, ~661 URLs including all /hr/blog/*, /en/blog/*, /en/press). Blog/press list pages are client-side rendered (raw HTML has no article anchors), so render individual article URLs with a headless browser OR just fetch each article URL from the sitemap (article pages carry more server content than the list pages). Monitor sitemap lastmod for new blog/press posts (A1/A4/A5/A6).

Site sits behind Cloudflare bot protection (managed JS challenge). Collect via a real headless browser (Playwright/Puppeteer with JS + realistic UA/session) to solve the interstitial, then scrape the /cir/ekonomija/{finansije,konkursi} and /lat/ equivalents; look for an RSS/category feed once inside a passing session. Plain curl/WebFetch cannot be used.

Informational pages on www.businessportal.gr are static HTML (200, scrapable). Company/GEMI-number/financial-statement lookup is on publicity.businessportal.gr — a Next.js SPA protected by Google reCAPTCHA v3, so its backend calls cannot be reliably reproduced headless. Use a real browser session (or check for an official GEMI bulk/open-data feed) for A1/A2 filings; results cap at 500 per query.

sources.recommended_method: Open security/issuer pages in a headless browser to capture the exact Angular XHR/export endpoints (network tab) — page data uses {{formatNumeric()}} Angular expressions so raw HTML is incomplete. Use the per-security CSV/JSON export for historical trading data; use /en/financial-reports-265/264 and issuer investor-notice pages for A1 disclosures. Alternatively pursue rest.zse.hr partner API.

Two paths: (1) Governance/ICT pages (ikt-asocijacija, organi-i-strucna-tijela, homepage) are static server-rendered HTML — scrape directly for A1/A5 (board/committee members). (2) Company Register is a client-side DataTables.net table (WordPress site) whose rows are NOT in the initial HTML (only the header row) — load in a headless browser, then either capture the ajax/data source populated by JS or trigger the built-in DataTables export buttons (CSV/Excel/print via jszip+buttons html5, which are present). admin-ajax.php exists (returns 400 without action) but the specific action/data endpoint was not exposed in static HTML.

Alternatively scrape the resourceView HTML pages. Per-dataset resource UUIDs are stable (e.g. КЗП dataset 3ebbecd4-5012-43b6-97cd-90e11528146e).

Cloudflare JS challenge blocks plain curl/WebFetch (HTTP 403 even with browser User-Agent). Use a real headless browser with Cloudflare-challenge solving for on-demand EIK dossiers. For authoritative, automatable company/financial data prefer the official Commercial Register (portal.registryagency.bg, which offers an open-data/API + annual financial statements) as the primary source, using papagal only as a convenience mirror.

Browser session / headless browser with real user-agent needed. Cloudflare bot protection blocks plain HTTP. Alternatively harvest article URLs via WebSearch/site: queries then fetch through a rendering fetcher. RSS (/feed/, /tag/greek-banks/feed/) is also 403.

Client-side pdfmake/export buttons suggest the full dataset is delivered to the browser.

Collect job listings from skywalker.jobs (reachable, 200) via HTML scrape; skywalker.gr itself requires a real browser session to pass the Cloudflare challenge. Consider partners.workable.com/skywalker for structured feed if partnering.

Use a headless/real browser (Cloudflare 'challenge' blocks curl even with a browser UA; content IS renderable — WebFetch succeeded). For structured/reliable collection request a Jooble partner API key. Search terms: 'работа в банка', bank names (e.g. 'работа банка дск').

For company/registry lookups, Ciela Info is a paid product — use the official free Търговски регистър (portal.registryagency.bg) instead. Ciela pages need browser rendering.

URLs (e.g. page 3 advanced search, page 13/30 detail), so requests are not cleanly reproducible with plain curl. Requires a real browser session to pass Cloudflare bot challenge; use headless browser with JS/cookie support (e.g. Playwright) rather than plain HTTP. Then scrape /jobs and /company/<id> pages.

Indeed enforces Cloudflare/anti-bot; all sample URLs return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients. Requires a headless real browser with anti-detection or an official/partner jobs API (legacy publisher API largely deprecated). Prefer local job boards for BiH/Albania coverage.

Requires a real browser session (headless Chrome/Playwright). The online.selekcija.hr host returns HTTP 403 to curl/WebFetch even with a desktop browser User-Agent (Cloudflare bot protection). Career pages are likely JS-rendered ATS listings; inspect XHR/fetch calls in a browser to find a JSON job-listing endpoint, otherwise render the page and scrape the DOM.

Direct curl/WebFetch reproduction blocked.
Cloudflare blocks automated fetches; much content is subscriber-gated. Use authenticated browser session for monitoring, or RSS if entitled. Manual monitoring otherwise.

GET https://jobs.worldline.com/search-jobs/Greece then paginate the /search-jobs/results?ActiveFacetID=Greece&CurrentPage=N endpoint; scrape rendered job cards. Scrape /search-top-employers/ with country=Greece filter; server-side HTML listing of certified employers. Confirm the exact filter query param / admin-ajax call in a browser session.

Not suitable for scraping: paywalled + aggressive bot protection. For A1/A5 signals use targeted keyword monitoring via a licensed news/API feed, RSS from primary company IR sources, or Bloomberg Terminal if licensed. Treat as manual.

Use a real browser session (rotating headers/rate limiting) to scrape result pages, OR register for Careerjet's official Job Search API (affid required). No public RSS found.

Job list is JS-rendered; use a browser session on the search page to capture the underlying XHR/JSON job-search endpoint (then replay with query params), or render with a headless browser. Endpoint not yet identified.

Low-value company marketing site. Homepage loads only with a real browser User-Agent (title 'Kupi i prodaj kriptovalute - BCX'); default/curl UA and the /en/ path return HTTP 403 'Access Forbidden'. For any collection, use a browser-like UA (Mozilla Windows) and scrape homepage/about; likely needs headless browser for full content.

Scrape the Agenda/Speakers pages for A1/A5 intel (who is speaking, which banks/fintechs attend). Interactive per-entity search only (Angular front-end backed by a REST API). Confirm the XHR endpoint via browser network capture; expect anti-bot/session tokens and no bulk export. Not suitable for mass collection.

Site returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch (both desktop Chrome and Safari UAs) — WAF/bot protection. Retrieve via a real headless browser (Playwright/Selenium with full browser fingerprint and cookies) or an approved proxy; the pages themselves are static HTML once the WAF challenge is passed. No CAPTCHA content observed, just a 403 gate.

Collect via a real browser / headless Chrome with realistic headers; site is publicly readable in-browser but blocks scripted clients. Target pages: /otvoreni-natjecaji/ (A2 tenders), /vijesti/ (A5 news), /o-nama/uprava/ (management).

Preferred: register a free Careerjet affiliate ID and use the Careerjet Job Search API for structured company/job data. Direct scraping is blocked by anti-bot (unusual-traffic/CAPTCHA interstitial served to non-browser clients).

Render with a headless browser (JS required). Homepage/listing returns only a ~3.6KB React shell via curl and WebFetch shows no listings. Capture the internal XHR/fetch (likely a JSON/GraphQL endpoint on api.joberty.com or /api) via browser devtools/network capture, then reproduce with proper User-Agent/headers. Paginate via page= and sort=created.

Scrape individual company pages by OIB slug (pattern /tvrtka/{name-slug}/OIB-{oib}) — these render headline financials publicly (revenue, EBIT, EBITDA, net profit, employee count, sector rank) as confirmed for Printec Croatia. Company OIBs can be enumerated from other sources.

Cloudflare blocks automated GET (403) even with browser/Googlebot UA. Use a real/headless browser session that passes the Cloudflare challenge, then scrape the category page or try a WordPress feed (e.g. /category/oglasi-za-posao/feed/) from within that session.

Client-rendered React SPA (returns empty root div). Render with a headless browser and capture XHR/fetch to identify the jobs backend API. Backend base is not exposed in the JS bundle (only a test host test.agencijaspektar.com appears); /api/* paths return the SPA HTML fallback, so the real endpoint needs a browser network capture.

Collect via a real browser session / headless browser that passes Cloudflare's JS challenge (both curl with browser UA and WebFetch returned 403). No RSS (/rss, /feed both 403). Once past the challenge, scrape /management and category pages for A5 appointment signals.

Do NOT target HERMES (submission side, login/OTP only). For A5 early-intent / issuer-disclosure data use the public ATHEX corporate announcements listing at athexgroup.gr (browser/JS-rendered) or ATHEX RSS/announcement feeds. Requires FT subscription + browser session; Cloudflare blocks automated fetches. Use licensed feed/RSS with logged-in session, or manual monitoring. RSS available at https://www.ft.com/greece?format=rss (subject to entitlement).

SAP SuccessFactors career site (detected 'successfactors' + OAuth2 authorize endpoint in page). Job search is JS-rendered; reproduce via headless browser, or locate the SF OData/RSS jobs feed for this company. Filter for Greece/Athens locations.

jobily.gr returns 403 to non-browser clients (anti-bot); use a real browser session, or better, collect Nexi Greece openings directly from Nexi's Oracle Cloud careers portal via nexigroup.com/careers/job-openings.
Open in a real browser and capture the XHR/fetch calls that populate the job board (likely a JSON API), then reproduce that endpoint. Static HTML (112 KB) contains no job data or exposed API path.

Blocked by Cloudflare (HTTP 403) to non-browser clients. Requires a real browser session (and likely login) to view listings; Wellfound uses an internal GraphQL API. Needs manual/browser-session validation - not reproducible with plain curl.

Job search at /el-gr/anazitisi-ergasias (category filters: Engineering/IT/Logistics/Office). Likely a backing JSON/search API behind the JS listing — capture XHR via browser session to reproduce; otherwise render page and scrape

Browser session needed: page returns HTTP 200 but empty body to WebFetch/curl (JS-rendered), and Citywire gates full articles behind registration/subscription. Use a rendering browser; article bodies likely require login.

Not directly automatable: Google for Jobs is a JS-rendered SERP widget with no public API, protected by anti-bot/CAPTCHA and ToS restrictions on scraping. Better to collect the underlying sources (jobseeker sites: kariera.gr, skywalker.gr, bank career pages) or use a licensed SERP/jobs API. Manual validation only.

Page is freely accessible but winner names render via JS filtering; use a rendering browser or inspect the WordPress admin-ajax/REST endpoint that supplies the filtered winners list. Then extract company + category + tier for banking/financial firms.

GET search-result HTML and parse the embedded JSON-LD ItemList (20 JobPosting entries per page); vary the /search/<region>/<role>-jobs path and paginate to enumerate tech hiring by Greek banks/employers

Scrape the media-releases hub for links; download individual media-release PDFs (predictable /content/dam/.../Media release <date> EN.pdf.coredownload.inline.pdf pattern). Homepage is AEM/JS-rendered so target the hub and PDFs directly, not the JS home page

Browser session required — front-end is served via AmazonS3/CDN with bot protection blocking plain requests. Drive with a headless/real browser or reverse-engineer the internal search API from network traffic (XHR JSON) with proper headers

Collect from the newsroom listing; the filter/results area is JS-driven (WebFetch shows 'No results found' server-side). Use browser session to render the list, or discover the backing news XHR/JSON endpoint. No RSS at /news/rss or /rss (404).

Use the public startup database on elevategreece.gov.gr (Mantis IMS dashboard) — needs a browser session to render/search; no open API or export exposed. The registry.* portal itself requires login and is not for bulk collection.
Retry later from a browser session; if TLS still fails the domain is likely parked/down. Company intel available via web search rather than the site.

Client-side rendered React SPA - listings load via a backend API (not present in static HTML). Discover the JSON/XHR endpoint via browser network inspection (DevTools/Chrome MCP), then reproduce it; filter listings for banking/finance categories.
Render via headless browser that clears the Cloudflare JS challenge (plain curl and browser-UA curl both blocked). Then scrape jobs/vacancies pages.
Vercel-hosted site (likely Next.js/React). Static HTML carries SEO meta; some content may be client-rendered — prefer headless browser for a /jobs or /careers open-roles page.

Render via headless browser that clears the Imperva/Incapsula JS+cookie challenge (curl returns only the _Incapsula_Resource challenge iframe; WebFetch returned empty body). Then scrape news/lajme and publications sections.

Login-gated SPA: root returns HTTP 302 to /login?redirect=%2F. Requires authenticated account; the app is JS-rendered and backed by a private GraphQL/JSON API only reachable inside a logged-in browser session. Cannot be reproduced with plain curl. Consider the public site welcometothejungle.com for country/company pages instead.

Cloudflare returns HTTP 403 to both curl and WebFetch (bot challenge). Collect via a real browser session; then locate the jobs listing page and any backing search endpoint. Confirmed a live Albanian recruitment company (Hire Me Company, Tirana).

CNBC blocks automated GETs (Akamai bot protection returns HTTP 403). Use CNBC's RSS feeds (e.g. https://www.cnbc.com/id/{topicId}/device/rss/rss.html) or a headless browser with realistic headers; otherwise access manually. Low priority / broad relevance for Croatia

WebSearch confirms the OTS listing exists at /ots and /OTS/hrvatska with item pages /vijest/{id}. Reproduce via headless Chrome, not plain HTTP.
Requires a real browser session (headless browser passing Cloudflare JS challenge) to render the speakers list; plain HTTP clients are blocked (403).

Fetch the careers homepage with a browser User-Agent (default fetch returns 404). Job openings render as cards; individual postings live at /jobs/{slug} (confirmed pattern on sibling tenant addiko-bank-bl). Use a headless browser or capture the TalentLyft jobs XHR for structured listings.
Cloudflare bot-protection blocks server-side requests (403 on member-news and /feed/). Requires a real browser session / headless browser with JS challenge solving, or an allow-listed IP/User-Agent.

Jobs section returns 200 but OLX is a JS-rendered SPA with anti-bot protection; use headless browser or investigate the OLX internal listing API (api/v1/offers style used by OLX Group). Filter jobs by keyword (e.g. bank/payments employers) to capture hiring/early-intent.
Wix site - JS-rendered; scrape via headless browser or query Wix blog data API (/_api/... or /blog-feed.xml if a Wix blog is enabled). RSS at /feed and /feed/ both 404.

Scrape HTML sections (banking/interest-rate/currency pages) with a browser-like User-Agent; Cloudflare returns 403 on the /rss endpoint (redirects to /rss/?url_stranice=rss then 403). Homepage itself served 200 to curl.

Subscribe to relevant EIN Presswire topic newsfeeds (Banking, Fintech, Albania/Balkans) via RSS; homepage returns 403 to automated fetch. Individual releases are indexable but the searchable wire is behind a paywall/subscription.

Fetch with a real browser User-Agent header (default curl UA gets HTTP 403 from CloudFront). Content is a JS/React app; use headless browser for full listings or inspect XHR/API endpoints in-browser.
